children: Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) will accelerate ~$500M of 2026 spending, boost buybacks beyond $13B done in 2025 and remove Banamex next year (incurring about $9B CTA loss), while targeting ROTCE just above 11%, strong NII growth and disciplined organic card and wealth expansion.
Citigroup To Boost Buybacks, Accelerate Spending
: Citigroup (C) will boost buybacks beyond $13B done in 2025 and accelerate ~$500M of spending this year, earmarked for severance, marketing in cards and wealth.
: Citigroup (C) CFO Gonzalo Luchetti said the bank expects return on tangible common equity (ROTCE) slightly above 11% for the year, per company summaries citing his forecast.
: Citigroup Inc. (C) plans to remove Mexico's Banamex from its balance sheet next year; management expects a currency translation adjustment loss related to the removal of approximately $9 billion.
Net Interest Income Near Top Outlook
: Citigroup (C) expects net interest income ex-markets near the top of its annual growth outlook, driven by client volume growth and pricing discipline across services, wealth and cards.
: Citigroup (C) reported a credit card delinquency rate of 1.29% at end of August per its SEC filing, showing the share of its card portfolio delinquent that month.
Focus On Organic Growth, Small Acquisitions
: Citigroup (C) says CFO: bank will focus on organic growth, remain open to small add-on acquisitions, and will avoid pursuing any transformative deals.
